row.scim_price_text: Included with every base product (no SCIM plan gate documented)
row.evidence: Lattice's help centre documents a SCIM API enabled from Admin > Settings > Platform > Integrations with no plan restriction, and the pricing page says every base product comes with Integrations.
row.notes: Status kept as free, but on weaker evidence than June: the current pricing page no longer names SSO or SCIM; it lists Integrations as included with all base products, and no help article ties SCIM or SSO to a plan. Pricing is now a Foundations package at $13/seat/mo (Performance $10, Goals & OKRs $8, Engagement $4 sold separately), billed annually, $4,000 minimum annual agreement; Enterprise is quote-based. SCIM is users-only (no Groups, no Bulk). Entra has no official gallery provisioning app (custom non-gallery app; append ?aadOptscim062020 for deactivation). Google Workspace is SSO-only. Under the post-pilot rules SCIM works with several IdPs (Okta, OneLogin, JumpCloud, and Entra through a custom app), so it is not partial.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users' data is stored; they lose access to Lattice.

custom.how: Lattice extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:lattice:attributes:1.0:User carries birthDate, startDate, gender and any Lattice custom field (field name in camelCase).

limitations.text: No SCIM Groups and no Bulk; users cannot be assigned to Lattice groups via SCIM.

No official Microsoft Entra provisioning integration: use a custom non-gallery app and append ?aadOptscim062020 to the tenant URL to make deactivation work; Entra PATCH and attribute-mapping filters are not supported.
Job Architecture, Compensation, middle name, pronouns, ethnicity, sexual orientation and (for most IdPs) phone number cannot be synced via SCIM.
Preferred name and display name are only set when the account is first created; later syncs do not change them.
Okta pushes the full profile on update, so unmapped attributes can wipe existing Lattice values.
The SCIM token is a Lattice API key; revoking it, or the creating admin leaving, breaks the integration.
Fields locked by SCIM cannot be unlocked without disabling SCIM.

endpoints.purpose: Paginated list of users (active by default)

limitations.text: The Talent API is read-mostly: write-back is documented only for Goals; there are no user create/update/deactivate endpoints (user lifecycle is via SCIM or HRIS sync).
API keys carry the privileges of the creating user and stop working if that user is no longer active.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS integrations (Namely, Zenefits, BambooHR, Workday, ADP, Sapling, Gusto, Personio, UKG, TriNet, Humaans, HiBob, Rippling)
